description: BI Worldwide storefront user created per test with a role (Super Admin, Admin, Sales Rep, Market Coordinator), optional market and status, a password for the storefront login, and a run-unique token in first name, last name and email. BMP-38.

store.description: Store code the user belongs to (ZnodePortal.StoreCode), e.g. the BIWW storefront

role.description: BIWW role name: Super Admin, Admin, Sales Rep or Market Coordinator

portalRole.description: AspNet Commerce Portal role sent as RoleName on user create, next to role: Web Admin (Admin), Super Admin, SalesRep, MarketCoordinator

market.description: Market name (Sales Rep, Market Coordinator); bind by reference to MARKET_AVAILABLE, e.g. @market.marketName

firstName.description: Text placed before the run-unique token in the first name (sort, special-character cases); the token always follows

lastName.description: Text placed before the run-unique token in the last name; the token always follows

emailLocalPart.description: Text added after the run-unique token in the email local part

asm.description: ASM value (Sales Rep, Market Coordinator); the create call does not require it; source open (cso.TblCustom_ASM.ASM is masked)

category.description: Benjamin Moore Product Category code (Admin), stored in the BIWW row Categories; bind by reference, e.g. @adminCategory.optionCode (ADMIN_CATEGORY_AVAILABLE)
